answers.core: `RenderingDeviceDriverMetal` is part of Godot's core rendering architecture (`drivers/metal/`).
answers.workaround: No. `RenderingDeviceDriver` is a core C++ rendering backend; it cannot be switched or implemented via GDScript/C# or command-line flags.
